taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: City dispatchers produced requests to move vehicles obstructing emergency response. The first-responder hotline stalled those requests on prolonged holds while obstructions persisted. A 40-minute ambulance delay and repeat relocation requests establish a material failure to deliver the signal in time for its required response. The internal queue or staffing fault remains unknown.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Waymo paused service and directed staged fleet retrieval. This demonstrates a concrete restriction mechanism. City reports continued after suspension, so this finding does not imply immediate clearance or effective resolution of every obstruction.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The responsible operator restricted autonomous fleet operation during the adverse event.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The confirmation backlog degraded fleet operation during the outage. City agencies additionally report fire, ambulance and transit obstructions and prolonged response-channel delays. These establish an adverse operational and safety-support outcome without assigning sole responsibility for citywide gridlock or inferring patient injury.
retained_rows.identification_basis: A provider-reported fleet capacity problem affected autonomous operation under an infrastructure outage.
